environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate with a custom task definition. The task uses a read-only root filesystem with specific writable tmpfs mounts at /var/app/uploads (noexec,nosuid,size=50m) and /tmp (noexec,nosuid,size=20m). The container image uses a distroless-style build where /bin/sh, /bin/bash, and all binaries under /usr/bin except pdflatex and convert are removed at build time. The ECS task role has no network permissions and the task is placed in a subnet with a security group that allows inbound 8080 from the ALB only and has NO outbound rules (all egress denied). Additionally, the texlive installation is patched: the shell-escape functionality in the deployed pdflatex binary is compiled with --disable-write18, meaning the -shell-escape flag is accepted but \write18 and \input|"..." calls are silently no-ops (this is the texlive-restricted Debian variant 'texlive-binaries' package version 2022.20220321-1 with restricted-shell-escape hardcoded at compile time, where only a fixed whitelist of programs - bibtex, makeindex, kpsewhich - can be invoked).

config.removed_binaries: all /usr/bin/* except pdflatex, convert; /bin/sh and /bin/bash removed
config.network_egress: security group with no outbound rules (implicit deny-all)
config.texlive_variant: texlive-binaries 2022.20220321-1 (restricted shell escape, write18 disabled at compile time, whitelist: bibtex,makeindex,kpsewhich)
config.pdflatex_flag_behavior: -shell-escape flag accepted but write18 calls are no-ops due to compile-time restriction
